description.value: Kisha Poppo is a Japanese all-you-can-eat buffet restaurant on Steveston Highway in Richmond, serving freshly prepared items with no time or item limits brought directly to the table. The restaurant offers both dine-in and takeout (with online ordering), plus delivery through Skip the Dishes and DoorDash. Located near the Steveston area cycling routes, it provides a substantial sit-down meal option for touring cyclists passing through Richmond.
